field.name: idSpecialities
field.label: COM_ELGERGASIA_GEO_SECTION
field.query: select s.idSpeciality, i.industry, s.speciality from #__elg_ergasia_industry_translation i inner join #__elg_ergasia_speciality spe on i.idIndustry = spe.idIndustry and i.{language} inner join #__elg_ergasia_speciality_translation s on s.idSpeciality = spe.id and s.{language} where s.idSpeciality >0 and i.idIndustry >0 order by i.industry , s.speciality
